items.html: And as written in the Idra of Naso, p. 131b: “Some of them were sweetened and some of them were not sweetened.” And the meaning is not that there are among them some kings who were sweetened and some who were not sweetened. Rather, the intention is “some of them” literally: from the portion of the kings themselves, from each and every part of each one of them, a part of it was sorted and sweetened, and a part of them, from each and every one of them, was not sweetened and remained below, as will be written, God willing.
